From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Subject: Redwood security/compliance follow-up and next steps

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the time and the detail on HealthCore's HIPAA and SOC 2 needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

- Redwood SOC 2 status: We are currently SOC 2 Type II in scope for access controls, change management, and incident response. We completed our annual audit in Q1 2026; auditor report available on request.
- Data residency & GDPR/HIPAA: Hosted (Redwood API) keeps customer data encrypted at rest and in transit. For PHI workloads you mentioned, our Private deployment (VPC) plus customer-managed KMS is the recommended path.
- Vendor security questionnaire: please send over your spreadsheet and we can start filling the security questionnaire. Rishi will take point on the technical controls and provide evidence where available.
- Roadmap asks: You mentioned future requirements around ISO 27001 and FedRAMP for some partner integrations. We discussed a potential timeline for SOC scope expansion and advisory to prioritize controls that map to FedRAMP. Lauren from Product will join those conversations.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Alicia: drop the vendor security questionnaire in reply (or share a Drive link) — we’ll start filling sections today.
2) Rishi: provide the SOC 2 summary + pointer to auditor report and list of evidence artifacts (we can redact where necessary).
3) Lauren: schedule a 30-min compliance roadmap call next week to align on ISO/FedRAMP asks and timelines.

If that looks good, I’ll wait for your questionnaire and confirm the internal owners.

Thanks,

—Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

Thanks — that summary is helpful. Attaching our vendor security questionnaire (VSA) and the initial scope notes. A few clarifications from our side:

- ISO/FedRAMP: this is longer-term for us (12–18 months) but we want to understand gaps now. If Redwood can map SOC controls to FedRAMP/ISO equivalencies, that will accelerate our internal approval.
